briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities as compute shortages intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has accelerated with multiple frontier model releases this month. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount around deployment at scale. Regulatory momentum builds in the US and EU amid ongoing capability jumps.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with major reasoning gains. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus launched alongside Meta's Llama 4 405B update. DeepSeek-V3 and xAI Grok-3 continue closing the gap on Western labs.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New red-teaming benchmarks show persistent jailbreak success rates above 40% on leading models.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units shipped. Microsoft and Google announce new $15B+ data center clusters in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reports AI chip demand exceeding supply forecasts by 35%.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a closed lab or open-weight collaboration by 2028?
